title: IML Dataset Entry
description: Schema for a single annotated entry in a Prosody Protocol training dataset. See EXECUTION_GUIDE.md Phase 10.

id.description: Unique identifier for this entry (unique within the dataset).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the entry was created. The format is advisory: loaders warn about, but accept, other non-empty values.

audio_file.description: Relative path to the audio file (WAV) within the dataset directory. It MUST NOT be absolute (/x, C:\x, \\host\x), contain a '..' segment, or contain a control character (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F).

transcript.description: Plain text transcript of the audio.

iml.description: IML-annotated version of the transcript. It MUST be a valid IML document.

speaker_id.description: Identifier for the speaker, or null if unknown.

emotion_label.description: Primary emotion label for the entry.

consent.description: Whether explicit consent was given for this data. Entries without it MUST NOT be stored or used (spec 8.1).
